title: A Beijing bar swapped free Wi-Fi for free DeepSeek tokens
excerpt: The AGI Bar in Beijing’s Zhongguancun tech district gives patrons free DeepSeek tokens instead of Wi-Fi, self-hosting the model on two Nvidia workstations. A frothy monument to China’s AI boom, and its bubble anxiety.
content_html:
In Beijing’s Zhongguancun district, the dense grid of universities and start-ups that likes to bill itself as China’s Silicon Valley, a small bar has found a neat way to distil the country’s artificial-intelligence boom into something you can actually drink.

The AGI Bar, opened last summer by an independent developer named Song De, does not bother with the usual offer of free Wi-Fi. It hands patrons free “tokens” instead, the units of AI usage that everyone in the trade now counts as carefully as money.

The mechanics are pleasingly literal. Two Nvidia workstations sit behind the bar, self-hosting DeepSeek’s V4 Flash model so that customers can prompt, tinker and code over a beer without paying a subscription to anyone.

“It’s quite common for bars to provide free Wi-Fi with routers,” Song told Reuters, “so I’ll provide free tokens.” That such a thing is even affordable owes everything to the way cheap Chinese models have closed in on their pricier Western rivals.

Logos of China’s major AI labs line the walls, the menu leans on sector in-jokes, and the house cocktail, the AGI, arrives as a glass almost entirely full of beer foam, a wry nod to the frothy hype that has swollen around the industry.

It is the kind of gag that only works in a room full of people who build the thing they are teasing.

According to visitors, the extras lean into the same joke. Regulars can buy a “Drinking Plan” that hands over free beer for a year, order a brew called the “AGI bubble”, and glance up at a screen cycling through job openings at AI companies while they work.

The result is part watering hole, part recruitment board, part group therapy for a sector that cannot quite decide whether it is on the verge of god-like machines or an almighty crash.

The joke lands because the economics beneath it are entirely real. DeepSeek became a global name in early 2025, when its cheap, capable models set off what many described as a “Sputnik moment” for American AI, and the lab has spent the time since dragging the price of frontier-grade intelligence steadily downwards.

Running V4 Flash on a pair of workstations, cheaply enough to give the output away with a lager, is only thinkable because DeepSeek and its domestic rivals have driven the cost of inference through the floor and kept cutting from there.

That is precisely the shift rattling Silicon Valley. DeepSeek’s knack for matching far more expensive Western systems at a fraction of the cost has forced OpenAI and Anthropic to defend not only their benchmarks but their prices, and Beijing has come to treat the lab as a matter of national pride and strategic leverage.

A bar handing out DeepSeek tokens as freely as bar snacks is, in its own small way, a monument to that confidence, a sign that in China the technology has already crossed from the lab into the culture.

There is a nervier reading, too. The foam-topped AGI cocktail is, after all, a joke about a bubble, and plenty of people inside the industry quietly share the worry that valuations, DeepSeek’s included, have sprinted well ahead of revenue.

The lab has lately begun charging more at peak hours and softening its rock-bottom pitch, a reminder that even the great disruptor eventually has to make the sums add up. Cheap intelligence is thrilling until someone has to pay for the workstations.

For now, the AGI Bar is happy to serve the boom and the anxiety in the same round. Song’s clientele of engineers and founders can prompt a Chinese model for nothing, raise a glass to the coming of artificial general intelligence, and, should the whole thing deflate like the head on their beer, at least count on being first to hear about the next job going.

content_html_zh:
在北京的中关村地区，大学和初创企业密集，喜欢将自己标榜为中国的硅谷，一家小酒吧找到了一种巧妙的方式，将中国人工智能的繁荣提炼成你可以实际饮用的东西。

AGI 酒吧于去年夏天由一位名叫宋德的独立开发商开设，并没有提供通常提供的免费 Wi-Fi。 相反，它向顾客提供免费的“代币”，即人工智能使用的单位，现在行业中的每个人都像金钱一样仔细计算。

其机制非常直白。 吧台后面有两个 Nvidia 工作站，自托管 DeepSeek 的 V4 Flash 模型，这样顾客就可以边喝啤酒边提示、修补和编码，而无需向任何人付费。

宋告诉路透社：“酒吧提供带路由器的免费 Wi-Fi 是很常见的，所以我会提供免费的代币。” 这样的东西甚至可以负担得起，这一切都要归功于廉价的中国车型已经逼近了价格更高的西方竞争对手。

墙上挂满了中国主要人工智能实验室的标志，菜单以行业内的笑话为主，而自制鸡尾酒 AGI 的玻璃杯几乎装满了啤酒泡沫，这是对整个行业泡沫炒作的讽刺。

这种玩笑只有在满屋子的人都在建造他们所嘲笑的东西的情况下才有效。

据参观者称，群众演员都在讲同一个笑话。 常客可以购买“饮酒计划”，获得一年的免费啤酒，订购一种名为“AGI bubble”的啤酒，并在工作时抬头浏览屏幕上循环显示人工智能公司的职位空缺。

结果既是水坑，又是招聘委员会，又是对一个无法完全确定自己是否处于上帝般机器或万能崩溃边缘的行业的集体治疗。

这个笑话之所以成功，是因为其背后的经济学原理是完全真实的。 DeepSeek 于 2025 年初成为全球知名公司，当时其廉价、功能强大的模型引发了许多人所说的美国人工智能的“人造卫星时刻”，此后该实验室一直在努力拉低前沿级智能的价格。

在一对工作站上运行 V4 Flash，成本足够低，可以用啤酒来提供输出，这是可以想象的，因为 DeepSeek 及其国内竞争对手已经大幅降低了推理成本，并不断削减。

这正是令硅谷感到不安的转变。 DeepSeek 能够以极低的成本匹配昂贵得多的西方系统的能力，迫使 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 不仅要捍卫自己的基准，还要捍卫自己的价格，而北京方面已经开始将该实验室视为民族自豪感和战略影响力的问题。

一家像酒吧小吃一样免费发放 DeepSeek 代币的酒吧，从其本身的小角度来说，就是这种信心的一座纪念碑，这标志着在中国，这项技术已经从实验室进入了文化。

还有一种更紧张的阅读方式。 毕竟，泡沫顶上的 AGI 鸡尾酒是一个关于泡沫的笑话，许多业内人士都悄悄地担心，包括 DeepSeek 在内的估值已经远远超过了收入。

该实验室最近开始在高峰时段收取更多费用，并软化其最低价，这提醒人们，即使是伟大的颠覆者最终也必须让费用加起来。 廉价的情报令人兴奋，直到有人不得不为工作站付费。

目前，AGI Bar 很乐意同时服务于繁荣和焦虑。 宋的工程师和创始人客户可以免费推广中国模式，为通用人工智能的到来举杯，而且，如果整个事情像啤酒上的酒头一样泄气，至少可以指望第一个听到下一份工作的消息。
